lesson_title: Selling on Trust: The Exercise Book Under the Counter
hook_text: Every corner shop that ever gave credit kept a secret book. Accounting just grew it up.
clip_script: Every neighbourhood shop that ever gave credit had one: the exercise book under the counter. A page for each person. Take now, pay month end — and the shopkeeper writes it down, because memory is generous and business cannot afford generous. That page-per-person book is the Debtors Ledger. And here is the beautiful lock: add up all the pages, and the total MUST equal the street's one line. The same promises, counted two ways.
visual_style: A worn exercise book morphing into a clean ledger; names becoming personal accounts; all pages stacking into one glowing control line.
pacing: Gentle open, quickening as the system assembles, crisp landing on the lock.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to run a whole credit month, forwards and in reverse.
